summary_ja: この告示を平成23年12月31日から適用し、一部の規定は公布の日から適用する。
summary_en: Provides that this Public Notice applies from December 31, 2011, except for certain provisions that apply from the date of promulgation.
paragraphs: This Public Notice applies from December 31, 2011; provided, however, that the provisions of Article 1, item (xxxvi)(g) and Article 26, paragraph (2) of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy Status of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of the Assets, etc. Held by Such Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. as amended by this Public Notice (referred to as the "New Public Notice" in the following Article) apply from the date of promulgation.

sections_en.s01: Supplementary Provisions (FSA Public Notice No. 61 of May 27, 2011)
